name: Vault Notes
description: Reference notes module for Modula Module Standard 1.2 with optional provider-neutral AI product actions.

permissions.reason: Create and update account-scoped Vault Notes records.
Trash, restore and permanently delete account-scoped Vault Notes records.
Publish account-scoped search projections for notes and folders.
Emit redacted Vault Notes lifecycle events.
Request optional host-mediated AI product actions for explicit user review.
Stream optional AI suggestions without mutating notes.
Validate structured AI suggestions before preview or application.
Use the current authorised private note as AI context when the user triggers an AI action.

capabilities.reason: Persist notes, folders, tags, links, versions and saved-source references.
Expose declarative note, folder and tag actions.
Describe function metadata and side effects.
Use host generic migrations when needed.
capabilities.degradedBehavior: Vault Notes remains uninstallable until host generic record support is available.

capabilities.reason: Expose optional user-triggered AI product actions.
capabilities.degradedBehavior: Vault Notes remains fully usable without AI.

productActions.name: Summarise note
productActions.description: Generate a preview-only summary from one authorised note revision.

productActions.name: Suggest title
productActions.description: Generate title suggestions without applying them automatically.

productActions.name: Rewrite selection
productActions.description: Rewrite selected note text and show an original/proposed preview.

productActions.name: Extract action items
productActions.description: Extract action-item suggestions without creating Tasks records.

productActions.name: Suggest tags
productActions.description: Suggest tags without creating or assigning them automatically.
